$comment: Baseline generated from the existing top-level packs/ directories. STATUS: DOCUMENTATION ONLY - NOT ENFORCED. 'locked: true' is intended to mean that CI fails any pull request touching a file under that directory, but the workflow that would do it (.github/workflows/datapack-immutability.yml) does not exist in this repository and scripts/datapack_lock/check_lock.py is not invoked by any workflow or Gradle task. Nothing currently blocks a change to a locked pack; the flag is a convention for reviewers only. Intended procedure once enforcement exists: open a PR that sets the entry to 'locked: false' and get it reviewed/merged first, make your change and merge it, then open a follow-up PR that sets it back to 'locked: true'. New top-level directories under packs/ that are not listed here at all are allowed through (that's how new packs get added) but should be added to this file, locked, in a prompt follow-up PR.
